lay_text: My GP sent me to the stomach doctors about two weeks ago; they put a camera down and said the bleeding wasn't from my stomach. Then I saw a dentist, who gave me tablets to stop the bleeding for two days, but they didn't help. Then the blood in my urine started.
They did a camera test before I came in. They said there was no bleeding in my food pipe or stomach, it was coming from my mouth.
